Who an SOS wakes, in order

RYou

MMHotline keeps waking you until you claim the incident.

When an SOS comes from an alert source, MMHotline first gives the triage agent up to 3 minutes to look into it before waking anyone.

Your availability

On call

You are available.

Nobody else is available, so an SOS would still wake you: when nobody is available, MMHotline wakes everyone on the team.

For example 30m, 2h, or 3d, up to 30 days.

Hand over early

You are on call.

To hand over sooner, ask the next responder to sign in and choose Take on call on the On call page. MMHotline then wakes the next responder first, until the time chosen by the next responder.

Mute the team

Not muted

For planned work. While the team is muted, MMHotline sends no Pushover notifications or automated voice calls. Other contact methods send only if “Send even when the team is muted” is on.

For example 30m, 2h, or 3d, up to 30 days.
